properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 12 at 8:32PM PDT until October 12 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Medford OR
properties.description:

7 to 10 ft at 8 to 10 seconds.

* WHERE...All areas.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds and/or steep seas could capsize or
damage smaller vessels.

remain in port and avoid the area of hazardous conditions.

properties.areaDesc: Waters from Cape Blanco OR to Pt. St. George CA from 10 to 60 nm
properties.headline: Hazardous Seas Warning issued October 12 at 8:32PM PDT until October 12 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Medford OR
properties.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 kt with a few gusts up to 40 kt
and steep to very steep wind-driven seas of 8 to 12 ft. Winds
ease to 10 to 20 kt and seas gradually subside to 6 to 8 ft
Monday night and Tuesday, but seas remain hazardous to small
craft.

* WHERE...All areas, with the strongest winds and steepest seas
from around Port Orford southward.

* WHEN...For the Hazardous Seas Warning, until 11 PM PDT this
evening. For the Small Craft Advisory, from 11 PM this evening
to 11 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong, gusty winds and steep to very steep
hazardous seas could capsize or damage vessels.

* View the hazard area in detail at https://go.usa.gov/x6hks
properties.instruction:
Recreational boaters should remain in port. Commercial vessels
should prepare for very steep seas and consider remaining in port
until conditions improve.
